notes_for_editor: Two map sources, both Pastmaps summaries of USGS sheets (1970 and 2012); the feature names look like map labels, but the descriptions read as machine-written, so check the USGS sheets themselves before publishing. OSM node 357997280 tags lattice observation tower; not on NHLR or FFLOS Mississippi lists. No built date, staffing or fate found. Firetower Road on the 2012 map may be an access clue; not verified. The 1970 sheet text was read only through a Pastmaps summary. Absence checked 2026-10-21: the full NHLR Mississippi list and the FFLOS Mississippi list (3 entries) contain no Tilton entry.
